d: Ende der 1920er Jahre sticht der junge Errol Flynn mit Freunden und einer geheimnisvollen Schatzkarte in See. Auf dem Weg nach Papua-Neuguinea geraten sie in gefährliche Abenteuer, verfolgt von einem skrupellosen Drogenbaron.

Jamal (Martin Lawrence), a lazy employee at a medieval park, falls into the moat – and lands in the year 1328! While everyone believes he is a royal court messenger, he thinks the real past is a particularly realistic attraction. A hilarious time travel comedy full of misunderstandings!

In the 1950s, Hollywood actor David Merrill (Rover De Niro) becomes a victim of the anti-communist witch hunt. Wrongfully accused, he must fight against baseless allegations – a gripping drama about paranoia and the loss of freedom and dignity.

The dark wizard Rumpelstiltskin has destroyed a magical mirror, creating a portal that will transport him directly into the modern human world. There, he intends to subjugate humanity.
